claim: This round's sweep (R6-07) added two outcomes to EI-V11-EDGE-5 (l. 4784): at decay level 0, "a building under a disaster look drawn at the look's level (V11 §3.25.9)"; at level 1, "each from its entry week into the plan (V03 §5.6 (2) (a)–(b))". Its test cell still reads "T-V11-47; T-V11-45 (s), (u)", and neither test runs either case. T-V11-47 is a compile bar over the two tables. T-V11-45 (u) (l. 5044) lists "the damage tables' edges (levels 0 and 1, a material with no row, a range edited out of its shares)" under the bar "every stated outcome"; no disaster look and no late-entering element is among its cases. The outcomes are V03's and §10.2's, run by T-V3-40 (b) (V03 l. 2907: "a building under the look and its own decay draws the higher level on every element") and T-V3-39 (c) (an element a re-cut or `extend` adds, from its entry week). The row names neither. One builder of T-V11-45 (u) builds a disaster-look fixture to meet "every stated outcome"; another does not. Nothing built changes: a test list omitting a case its own row names (R6-01), MINOR.
required_change: EI-V11-EDGE-5's test cell (l. 4784): "T-V11-47; T-V11-45 (s), (u)" → "T-V11-47; T-V11-45 (s), (u); T-V3-40 (b) (a building under a disaster look at the look's level), T-V3-39 (c) (an element compared from its entry week)".
